evidence: log loss +0.0131 (95% interval +0.0051 to +0.0206). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

379 picks, ROI -1.0% (95% interval -8.4% to +5.9%), win rate 58.8% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 29% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.12 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,906 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,766; a 1% edge takes 44,146. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
